title.en: Chapter 19 — The Garrison in the Stockade

sentences.en: We sat guarding in turns all night.
The food was little and the water less.
The captain wrote everything in a notebook.
He counted the days and counted the bullets.

sentences.ar: حكيت لهم عن بن غن ومركبه.
sentences.en: I told them about Ben Gunn and his boat.
The doctor listened and said nothing.

sentences.ar: بس شفت بعينه إنه فكر بإشي.
sentences.en: But I saw in his eye that he had thought of something.
